brief:
Al Jazeera senior political analyst Marwan Bishara has published a new book examining the twelve days between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's October 7 speech and President Joe Biden's subsequent Oval Office address. Titled "Twelve Days That Shook the Middle East: Origins of a Genocide," the work, Democracy Now! reported, analyzes the critical period that shaped the trajectory of the conflict.

Bishara's analysis focuses on the diplomatic and political decisions made during those pivotal days, when U.S. foreign policy responses were formulated alongside Israeli military planning.
